clues: This large town sits in the low hills at the foot of a huge mountain range in north India. It stands on the banks of a river, south of high peaks.
Most of the rain here falls in one short burst from July to September. Hot, wet summers and cool winters are shaped by the high hills just behind the town.
It was set up in 1834 as a market for hill folk. They came down to trade here when the cold months made the hills hard to live in.
In 2025 this place hosted a huge sports meet for the whole country. Teams from all over India came to its Gaulapar grounds to compete.
One part of town is known as the gate to the hill region. Most trips into the high hills of the north start right there.
